keyboard.description: Moves focus to the previous day within the current week.
Moves focus to the next day within the current week.
Moves focus to the same day of the week in the previous week.
Moves focus to the same day of the week in the next week.
Moves focus to the first day of the current month.
Moves focus to the last day of the current month.
Moves focus to the same day of the month in the previous month.
Moves focus to the same day of the month in the next month.
Selects the focused date and closes the date picker.
Closes the date picker without selecting any date.

open.description: Whether the date picker is open

disabled.description: Whether the date picker is disabled

invalid.description: Whether the date picker is invalid

readOnly.description: Whether the date picker is read-only

inline.description: Whether the date picker is rendered inline

numOfMonths.description: The number of months to display

showWeekNumbers.description: Whether the week number column is shown in the day view

selectionMode.description: The selection mode (single, multiple, or range)

maxSelectedDates.description: The maximum number of dates that can be selected (only for multiple selection mode).

isMaxSelected.description: Whether the maximum number of selected dates has been reached.

view.description: The current view of the date picker

getWeekNumber.description: Returns the ISO 8601 week number (1-53) for the given week (array of dates).

getDaysInWeek.description: Returns an array of days in the week index counted from the provided start date, or the first visible date if not given.

getOffset.description: Returns the offset of the month based on the provided number of months.

getRangePresetValue.description: Returns the range of dates based on the provided date range preset.

getMonthWeeks.description: Returns the weeks of the month from the provided date. Represented as an array of arrays of dates.

isUnavailable.description: Returns whether the provided date is available (or can be selected)

weeks.description: The weeks of the month. Represented as an array of arrays of dates.

weekDays.description: The days of the week. Represented as an array of strings.

visibleRangeText.description: The human readable text for the visible range of dates.

valueAsDate.description: The selected date as a Date object.

valueAsString.description: The selected date as a string.

focusedValueAsDate.description: The focused date as a Date object.

focusedValueAsString.description: The focused date as a string.

selectToday.description: Sets the selected date to today.

setValue.description: Sets the selected date to the given date.

setTime.description:
Sets the time for a specific date value.
Converts CalendarDate to CalendarDateTime if needed.

setFocusedValue.description: Sets the focused date to the given date.

setOpen.description: Function to open or close the calendar.

focusMonth.description: Function to set the selected month.

focusYear.description: Function to set the selected year.

getYears.description: Returns the months of the year

getYearsGrid.description:
Returns the years of the decade based on the columns.
Represented as an array of arrays of years.

getDecade.description: Returns the start and end years of the decade.

getMonths.description: Returns the months of the year

getMonthsGrid.description:
Returns the months of the year based on the columns.
Represented as an array of arrays of months.

format.description: Formats the given date value based on the provided options.

setView.description: Sets the view of the date picker.

getDayTableCellState.description: Returns the state details for a given cell.

getMonthTableCellState.description: Returns the state details for a given month cell.

getYearTableCellState.description: Returns the state details for a given year cell.

locale.description: The locale (BCP 47 language tag) to use when formatting the date.

createCalendar.description:
A function that creates a Calendar object for a given calendar identifier.
Enables non-Gregorian calendar support (Persian, Buddhist, Islamic, etc.)
without bundling all calendars by default.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the date picker. Useful for composition.

name.description: The `name` attribute of the input element.

required.description: Whether the date picker is required

invalid.description: Whether the date picker is invalid

outsideDaySelectable.description: Whether day outside the visible range can be selected.

min.description: The minimum date that can be selected.

max.description: The maximum date that can be selected.

closeOnSelect.description:
Whether the calendar should close after the date selection is complete.
This is ignored when the selection mode is `multiple`.

openOnClick.description: Whether to open the calendar when the input is clicked.

defaultValue.description:
The initial selected date(s) when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected date(s) of the date picker.

defaultFocusedValue.description:
The initial focused date when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the focused date of the date picker.

numOfMonths.description: The number of months to display.

startOfWeek.description:
The first day of the week.
 `0` - Sunday
 `1` - Monday
 `2` - Tuesday
 `3` - Wednesday
 `4` - Thursday
 `5` - Friday
 `6` - Saturday

fixedWeeks.description:
Whether the calendar should have a fixed number of weeks.
This renders the calendar with 6 weeks instead of 5 or 6.

showWeekNumbers.description: Whether to show the week number column in the day view.

onValueChange.description: Function called when the value changes.

onFocusChange.description: Function called when the focused date changes.

onViewChange.description: Function called when the view changes.

onVisibleRangeChange.description: Function called when the visible range changes.

onOpenChange.description: Function called when the calendar opens or closes.

isDateUnavailable.description: Returns whether a date of the calendar is available.

selectionMode.description:
The selection mode of the calendar.
- `single` - only one date can be selected
- `multiple` - multiple dates can be selected
- `range` - a range of dates can be selected

maxSelectedDates.description:
The maximum number of dates that can be selected.
This is only applicable when `selectionMode` is `multiple`.

format.description: The format of the date to display in the input.

parse.type: ((value: string, details: LocaleDetails) => DateValue | undefined) | undefined
parse.description: Function to parse the date from the input back to a DateValue.

placeholder.description: The placeholder text to display in the input.

defaultView.description: The default view of the calendar

minView.description: The minimum view of the calendar

maxView.description: The maximum view of the calendar

positioning.description: The user provided options used to position the date picker content

open.description: The controlled open state of the date picker

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the date picker when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the date picker.

inline.description: Whether to render the date picker inline

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Root.data-empty: Present when the content is empty

Content.data-side: The side of the trigger that the content is positioned on
Content.data-inline: Present when the content is inline

DayTableCellTrigger.data-today: Present when the date represents today
DayTableCellTrigger.data-unavailable: Present when the date is unavailable based on the min and max date
DayTableCellTrigger.data-range-start: Present when is the start of a range
DayTableCellTrigger.data-range-end: Present when is the end of a range
DayTableCellTrigger.data-in-range: Present when is within the range
DayTableCellTrigger.data-outside-range: Present when is outside the range
DayTableCellTrigger.data-weekend: Present when is a weekend day
DayTableCellTrigger.data-hover-range-start: Present when is the start of the hovered range
DayTableCellTrigger.data-hover-range-end: Present when is the end of the hovered range

MonthTableCellTrigger.data-outside-range: Present when is outside the range
MonthTableCellTrigger.data-range-start: Present when is the start of a range
MonthTableCellTrigger.data-range-end: Present when is the end of a range
MonthTableCellTrigger.data-in-range: Present when is within the range
MonthTableCellTrigger.data-hover-range-start: Present when is the start of the hovered range
MonthTableCellTrigger.data-hover-range-end: Present when is the end of the hovered range

YearTableCellTrigger.data-outside-range: Present when is outside the range
YearTableCellTrigger.data-range-start: Present when is the start of a range
YearTableCellTrigger.data-range-end: Present when is the end of a range
YearTableCellTrigger.data-in-range: Present when is within the range
YearTableCellTrigger.data-hover-range-start: Present when is the start of the hovered range
YearTableCellTrigger.data-hover-range-end: Present when is the end of the hovered range

Trigger.data-side: The side of the trigger that the trigger is positioned on
